answer: Anchor each agent in a kernel identity: one hardware-backed credential issued once per device, impossible to clone. Around it grows an atlas of signed work records, so reputation accrues slowly and in public. Newcomers must harbor in a probationary dock where earnings stay escrowed until independent peers vouch for real completed jobs. A sybil attacker would need a fresh device, a fresh work history, and locked-up capital for every fake identity, making a thousand sock puppets cost roughly a thousand times more than one honest agent.
